headline: Professor Murder Rides the Subway is a forgotten slice of dance punk perfection
summary: Reviewer rediscovered the concise Professor Murder Rides the Subway EP. It's hailed as a forgotten gem of mid-aughts dance-punk. The EP perfectly captures the unique NYC indie band sound of that era.

headline: Enormous 12TB Steam leak includes abandoned Half-Life 2: Episode 3 assets
summary: Over 12 terabytes of Steam game data from 2003-2013 has been leaked. The massive archive includes assets for the canceled Half-Life 2: Episode 3. Content cut from Portal 2 and other games has also been discovered.

headline: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope launches to study dark matter and dark energy
summary: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope successfully launched after overcoming funding hurdles. It will journey a million miles to orbit at the Sun-Earth L2 point. The telescope will conduct an unprecedented survey to study dark matter and energy.

headline: Texas Governor Abbott blocks funding for more Flock cameras
summary: Texas Governor Greg Abbott froze state spending on Flock AI surveillance cameras. This move follows growing public backlash against the camera systems. An investigation revealed Texas spent over $30 million on Flock cameras via insurance fees.

headline: Lanterns Season 1, Episode 3 Review & Recap: 'OutKast'
summary: The review covers 'Lanterns' Season 1, Episode 3, titled 'OutKast.' The episode delivers a distinct and successful superhero origin story. This unique approach significantly enhances the series.

headline: GTA 5's Michael Actor Defends GTA 6 After Doubters Say Rockstar's Games Look Too Similar
summary: Ned Luke, the voice of GTA 5's Michael De Santa, defended GTA 6. He responded to critics who claim GTA 6 looks too much like GTA 5. Luke stated that these doubters are 'out of their minds.'

headline: The Best Deals Today: LEGO Star Wars, Dragon Quest I & II HD-2D Remake, Jurassic Park 4K Collection, and More
summary: This article highlights the best deals available today. Featured offers include LEGO Star Wars and Dragon Quest I & II HD-2D Remake. Also available is the Jurassic Park 4K Collection, among other promotions.

headline: Ridley Scott's The Dog Stars Bombs in Theaters With $19 Million Global Opening
summary: Ridley Scott's new film, The Dog Stars, bombed at the box office. It secured an estimated $19.3 million globally in its opening weekend. The movie's performance is considered a significant disappointment.

headline: Prisoners freed early are returning to jail at rapid rate, governors tell BBC
summary: Prison governors report a high rate of early-released prisoners re-offending. PM Andy Burnham announced changes to the upcoming early release scheme. These new rules will ensure PC Harper's killers remain in jail.

headline: Patel to be replaced by Tugendhat as shadow foreign secretary
summary: Patel is expected to be replaced by Tugendhat as shadow foreign secretary. Kemi Badenoch plans a broader reshuffle of her front bench team. This comes after recent high-profile departures from the team.

headline: US strikes Iranian launchers on Larak Island in first known attack in weeks
summary: The US launched strikes on Iranian launchers on Larak Island. This is the first known US attack on Iran since late July. Iran reports two people were killed and two injured in the strike.

headline: This actor was told he had Alzheimer's, now he's performing a one-man show
summary: Actor Peter Marinker was diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. Despite his diagnosis, he is now performing a one-man show. Marinker will perform one of Samuel Beckett's famous plays on a London stage.
